description: This file defines the EmployeeAttachmentService class, which manages employee attachment data including retrieval, saving, and deletion operations, utilizing a DAO and role-based access control features.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachmentService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to manage employee attachments, including CRUD operations and access control.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachmentDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the EmployeeAttachmentDao instance used for database interactions.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Retrieves a list of attachments for a specific employee and screen context.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee attachment by employee number and attachment ID.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachmentDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific employee attachment.

methods.name: saveEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Saves an EmployeeAttachment entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Deletes multiple attachments for an employee based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Access-controlled retrieval of an employee attachment, considering user permissions.
